16 terrorists killed in separate security forces, police operations across Balochistan: state media At least 16 terrorists were killed during separate military and police operations in Balochistan’s Mastung, Turbat and Quetta districts on Wednesday, state media reported.According toRadio Pakistan, security forces killed two terrorists affiliated with Fitna al Hindustan during an intelligence-based operation in the Jausak area of Turbat.The state hasdesignatedBalochistan-based terrorist groups asFitna al HindustantohighlightIndia’s alleged role in terrorism and destabilisation across Pakistan.Meanwhile,Pakistan Televisionreported that security forces continued operations against terrorists in Balochistan under Raddul Fitna-3.In Mastung, nine terrorists were killed after they attempted to attack a checkpost, according to the state broadcaster.
